scope.slot_semantics: E1/E2/E3 are original v0.4 display slots. A displayed Z4 row is excluded from the E score population and the remaining E rows are not renumbered. Slot is location/order, never a quality label.

native_evidence_family_percentile.definition: DEV-frozen empirical midrank percentile, within current_family, of native_evidence_raw

native_evidence_raw_by_family.ES_M1_8H_R2_T0.50: native_rank_raw * (1 + distance_v) = causal pivot count in the source cluster
native_evidence_raw_by_family.EPM_M1_R2_A8H: native_rank_raw * (1 + distance_v) = 1 / (1 + causal source age hours / 8)
native_evidence_raw_by_family.ESM_BOTH_G120M: 1.0 for every observation; DEV within-family percentile fixed to 0.5

log1p_display_persistence_c5.definition: log1p(display_persistence_c5) from the causal display episode identity

confluence_count_e_families.definition: Number of distinct causal E families in the pre-dedup full candidate pool overlapping the displayed E interval or within 0.20*v by center at the same snapshot; Z4 excluded

center_stability_3_c5.definition: exp(-median normalized absolute center drift) over up to the three prior contiguous snapshots of the same display episode; 0.0 when no prior snapshot exists

nuisance_features_required_but_forbidden.minute_bin_30m: categorical 30-minute bin inside the 08:00-17:00 NY session
nuisance_features_required_but_forbidden.nearest_upper_z4_dist_v: causal distance to nearest upper Z4

explicitly_forbidden_features: future price or future zone state
display slot used as a positive quality contribution
zone width used in the displayed score contribution

model_design.nuisance_model: L2 logistic regression using only the nuisance design
model_design.full_model: L2 logistic regression using the identical nuisance design plus the frozen strength features
model_design.numeric_standardization: DEV mean and population SD ddof=0
model_design.categorical_encoding: lexicographic one-hot with first category as reference
model_design.displayed_raw_score: Only the fitted linear-predictor contribution of the strength features and current_family; intercept and every nuisance coefficient excluded
model_design.displayed_score_0_100: 100 times the DEV-frozen empirical midrank CDF of displayed_raw_score
